description_en: Queries the token consumption trend of a specified AgentTeams instance within a specified time range, supports grouping by time dimension, and returns time series data that can be used for charting
description_zh: 用于查询指定 AgentTeams 实例在指定时间范围内的 Token 消耗趋势，支持按时间维度分组，返回可用于绘图的时序数据
kebab_example: aliyun agentteams get-token-trend --instance-id i-xxx --start-time 1718000000000 --end-time 1718086400000 --group-by day --region cn-hangzhou
name: GetTokenTrend

parameters.help_en: The query start time. Unit: milliseconds (UNIX timestamp)
parameters.help_zh: 查询开始时间（毫秒时间戳）
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en: The query end time. Unit: milliseconds (UNIX timestamp)
parameters.help_zh: 查询结束时间（毫秒时间戳）
parameters.name: end_time

parameters.help_en: The grouping dimension, such as by day or by hour
parameters.help_zh: 分组维度，如按天或按小时
parameters.name: group_by
